name: rebase-train
description: Rebase one open PR onto the rig's default branch and force-push it back to its own branch, never merging. Detached checkout of the fetched PR head (checkout "pr": no run branch), rebase onto origin/<base>, a bounded conflict-resolver agent finishes a stopped rebase (skipped on a clean rebase; escalates instead of guessing), rig checks and tests re-run on the rebased tree, then the PR branch is pushed with --force-with-lease pinned to the head sha fetched at run start. No deploy step: the run ends done, the PR diff on GitHub stays the review surface. Start with `factory-run start --rig <rig> --workflow rebase-train --pr <n>`.
